units.title: and/but/or/so/because
units.theoryHtml:
Союзы соединяют два предложения и задают логику между ними:

СоюзСмыслПример
andи (добавление)I opened the door and saw him.
butно (противопоставление)He's rich but unhappy.
orили (выбор)Tea or coffee?
soпоэтому (следствие)It was late, so we went home.
becauseпотому что (причина)We stayed home because it was raining.

so vs because: причина идёт ПОСЛЕ because, следствие — ПОСЛЕ so: I was tired, so I slept (so = поэтому) ↔ I slept because I was tired (because = потому что).

⚠ Частые ошибки: двойной союз: Because it was late, so we left — только один из них! Также and не начинает отрицание: I don't like it and I won't buy it — корректно, но лучше ...it, so I won't buy it.

Мини-диалог:
— Why didn't you come? — Because I was sick. — You could have called! — I know, but my phone was dead, so I slept all day.

exercises.prompt: It was raining, ___ we took a taxi.
We stayed home ___ it was raining.
He's rich, ___ he isn't happy.
Do you want tea ___ coffee?
I opened the window ___ the room was still hot.
Choose the correct sentence:
options: Because it was cold, so I wore a coat.
It was cold, so I wore a coat.
It was cold, because I wore a coat.
So it was cold because I wore a coat.
exercises.explanation: Только один союз: причина → so + следствие.

exercises.prompt: Hurry up, ___ we'll miss the train!
She speaks English ___ French fluently.
I was hungry, ___ I made a sandwich.
He didn't call ___ (потому что) he lost my number.

units.title: when/while/before/after/until
units.shortDescription: Придаточные времени: до, после, пока, пока не.
units.theoryHtml:
Придаточные времени связывают два события по хронологии:

СоюзСмыслПример
whenкогда (момент)Call me when you arrive.
whileв то время как (процесс)While I was cooking, he was sleeping.
beforeпрежде чемWash your hands before you eat.
afterпосле того какAfter I finished, I left.
until/tillдо тех пор пока (не)Wait until I come back.
as soon asкак толькоAs soon as I saw him, I smiled.

Важно — о будущем: после when/before/after/until/as soon as НЕ ставим will, даже если речь о будущем: I'll call you when I arrive (не when I will arrive!).

when vs while: when — момент или короткое действие; while — длительный процесс-фон: The phone rang while I was having a shower.

⚠ Частые ошибки: Wait until I will come → until I come. After I will finish → After I finish.

Мини-диалог:
— What will you do when you graduate? — I'll travel before I start working.
— And I'll keep studying until I get my diploma. As soon as I finish, we'll celebrate!

exercises.prompt: I'll call you when I ___ home.
exercises.explanation: После when о будущем — Present: get.

exercises.prompt: ___ I was walking home, I saw an accident.
Wait here ___ I come back.
___ she finished, she went to bed.
___ I get my salary, I'll buy a new laptop.
Brush your teeth ___ you go to bed.
Choose the correct sentence:
options: When I will see him, I'll tell him.
When I see him, I'll tell him.
When I see him, I tell him.
When I saw him, I will tell him.

exercises.prompt: He fell asleep ___ the film.
Don't leave ___ (пока не) I tell you.
___ ___ (как только) the light turns green, we go.

units.title: during/for/while + How long does it take?
units.shortDescription: During the film vs for two hours — не путать.
units.theoryHtml:
Три способа сказать о времени:

СловоСмыслПример
during + сущ.в течение (что-то происходило внутри периода)During the film, my phone rang.
for + длительностьсколько длилосьWe talked for two hours.
while + предложениев то время какMy phone rang while we were watching the film.

Формула длительности: How long does it take...? — It takes + время: How long does it take to learn English? — It takes years! Прошедшее: It took me an hour. Будущее: It will take an hour.

⚠ Частые ошибки: during two hours → for two hours (during + существительное-событие, for + длительность). It takes me for an hour → It takes me an hour (без for!). How long does it takes? → does it take.

Мини-диалог:
— How long did it take you to fix the car? — About three hours. — During those three hours I called you five times!
— I know. Sorry. I was under the car — my phone was in the house.

exercises.prompt: We stayed in Rome ___ five days.
___ the lesson, nobody spoke.
My phone rang ___ we were talking.
How long does it ___ to get a visa?
It ___ me two hours to find the error.
Choose the correct sentence:
He fell asleep ___ the lecture.
___ we were waiting, it started to rain.
It will ___ (займёт) an hour to get there.
I haven't seen her ___ (в течение) years.
